scenes.name: ARC AND LINE
lines: On the Bell state, two measuring directions in the ZX plane at an angle theta agree with correlation cosine theta.
贝尔态上，ZX 平面内两个测量方向夹角为 θ，两边读数的关联就是 cos θ。
A toy classical model, hiding a random direction in each pair, draws a straight line instead.
一个经典玩具模型：每对粒子藏一个随机方向，画出来的却是一条直线 1 − 2θ/π。
The two meet at zero, ninety and one hundred eighty degrees.
Halfway between, at forty-five degrees, the arc stands higher by about zero point two oh seven.
走到半途的 45°，弧比折线高出约 0.207。

scenes.name: FOUR PAIRS
lines: Alice measures along Z or X. Bob turns his right-angled pair by forty-five degrees.
Alice 沿 Z 或 X 测量；Bob 把自己那对直角方向整体转过 45°。
Three pairs sit forty-five degrees apart; the last, one hundred thirty-five.
三对方向相隔 45°，最后一对相隔 135°。
Add the four, minus the last. Its cosine is negative, so it stacks upward too.
四项相加，最后一项带减号；它的余弦是负的，负负得正，也往上叠。
The arc stacks to two root two, about two point eight three. The line stacks to exactly two.
弧叠到 2√2 ≈ 2.828，折线恰好叠到 2。

scenes.name: TURN BOB
lines: Now turn Bob's pair slowly, from zero to ninety degrees.
现在慢慢转动 Bob 的这对方向，从 0° 转到 90°。
On the Bell state, the CHSH value is two root two, times cosine of phi minus forty-five degrees.
贝尔态上，CHSH 值等于 2√2 cos(φ − 45°)。
It starts at two, touches two root two only at forty-five degrees, and falls back to two.
它从 2 出发，只在 45° 碰到 2√2，又落回 2。
The toy model stays flat at two the whole way.
玩具模型一路平躺在 2 上。

scenes.name: SIXTEEN TABLES
lines: Can a cleverer classical model do better? Fix the hidden variable: every answer is plus or minus one.
更聪明的经典模型能不能做得更好？固定隐变量，每个答案都只是 +1 或 −1。
Write the sum as a nought times b nought plus b one, plus a one times b nought minus b one.
把四项之和写成 a₀(b₀ + b₁) + a₁(b₀ − b₁)。
One bracket is always zero, the other plus or minus two. All sixteen tables give exactly plus or minus two.
两个括号总有一个是 0，另一个是 ±2：十六张应答表，每张都恰好给出 ±2。
Averaging over hidden variables never leaves minus two to two. Lean checks this bound.
对隐变量加权平均，永远出不了 [−2, 2]。这条上界由 Lean 内核检验。

scenes.name: CEILING
lines: Where does the extra room come from? Square the CHSH operator.
多出来的空间从哪里来？把 CHSH 算子平方。
Lean checks that the square is four, plus a cross term of the two sides' commutators.
Lean 内核检验：平方等于 4，再加一个由两侧换位子相乘而成的交叉项。
For qubits, each commutator is an oriented area. Open both to right angles, and the largest eigenvalue of the square reaches eight.
单比特的换位子是有向面积；两侧张成直角，平方的最大本征值到 8。
So the ceiling is root eight. Lean checks that the forty-five degree operator reaches two root two, and no state goes higher.
所以天花板是 √8。Lean 内核检验：这个 45° 算子恰好达到 2√2，任何态都超不过。
Classical answers stop at two, the cosine arc at two root two: a factor of root two.
经典应答停在 2，余弦弧停在 2√2：相差 √2 倍。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirteen.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第十三章
